Class McpToolCallLimitService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.mcp.McpToolCallLimitService
@Service @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="gt.use", name="mcp", havingValue="true") public class McpToolCallLimitService extends Object
The three limits a tool call passes before its report runs: the request bucket of the user, the single running heavy report per user, and the daily budget of tool calls.

None of them raises a rights counter of the user. A client that repeats a call is not a misuse by the user, and the browser access of the same user is never affected: the bucket here is separate from the one of the browser filter.

    • reserveDailyCall

      public void reserveDailyCall(User user)
      Reserves one unit of today's (UTC) budget of tool calls before the report runs. The row of the day is created with a zero counter first; the reservation itself is a conditional increment, decided under the row lock, so concurrent calls at the last free unit cannot both succeed and the counter never exceeds the limit. A refused attempt does not raise the counter. Without a configured limit nothing is counted.

      The two statements run in separate transactions on purpose, each committed by its repository method. Within one transaction the INSERT IGNORE on an existing row keeps a shared lock that the following update has to upgrade, and two concurrent calls then deadlock each other. Committing the insert first releases that lock; the decision is still taken by the single conditional update.

      Parameters:
      user - the authenticated user; only read, never kept
      Throws:
      McpToolException - McpErrorCode.QUOTA_EXCEEDED when today's budget is used up
